outlook.title: Macro backdrop: Fed inflation concern; cross-market read remains conditional

notes.text: Catalyst chain: minutes describe inflation risks and possible policy tightening (observed in the minutes) → rate-sensitive valuation pressure is a scenario inference. The NY Fed survey index points in the same direction, but missing values and no verified yield/price reaction limit the inference. Bull counterpoint: several participants favored holding rates steady and described labor-market downside risks. Reassess after subsequent inflation, labor data and Treasury yields; research only.

description.text: Observed: September FOMC minutes state that most participants judged another increase in the federal funds rate likely to be appropriate by year-end, while emphasizing data dependence. Many saw inflation risks tilted upward; several supported holding rates steady and noted employment downside risks. This records the meeting discussion, not a new rate decision. Strongest disconfirmation of a hawkish interpretation: continued disinflation or weakening employment could support a hold.
